title: Dynamite Stick x3
body:
"Can be used to output a medium sized explosion, with a medium range. Any dynamite sticks which blow up other explosives will have a chain reaction, and explosives can be used to chop trees or break ores."

Description

The Dynamite Stick x3 has a moderate explosion, and a medium radius. Like any other explosive, it damages trees and ores, and can be used to open the gate at the Skull Rock to get the Skull.

Unlike bombs, dynamite blows up almost instantly in the event of a chain reaction.

Trivia

  • This item was originally priced at $4,500
